watches.label: Bagdad Rd, Potsdam
watches.why: A proposed solar array and steady road work keep Bagdad Rd in front of Potsdam's boards.

watches.label: Titus Mountain
watches.why: The closest skiing to Potsdam; its opening date and snow reports set the winter season.

watches.label: St. Lawrence County Legislature
watches.why: County budgets, taxes, and services are decided here, and they land on every town in the county.

watches.label: Potsdam village & town boards
watches.why: Potsdam's own boards set village and town taxes, zoning, and road work.

watches.label: Route 11 corridor
watches.why: The county's main road between Potsdam, Canton, and Gouverneur; a closure or crash on it reroutes everyone's day.

watches.label: Massena data center
watches.why: A proposed large data center near Massena is the county's biggest live development fight.
